title: Standing Entitlements Carried by Granite Ridge Season Pass Tiers
content:
Three standing entitlements are published per tier of the Granite Ridge Season Pass Programme: early lift loading before public opening, the priority lift lane, and the number of days of complimentary parking included with the pass for the season.

| Tier | Early lift loading before public opening | Priority lift lane | Parking days included |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Granite Ridge Four-Day Flex Pass | no | no | 0 |
| Granite Ridge Midweek Pass | no | no | 0 |
| Granite Ridge Local Pass | no | no | 5 |
| Granite Ridge Summit Pass | no | no | 10 |
| Granite Ridge Summit Plus Pass | yes | no | 20 |
| Granite Ridge Collective Unlimited Pass | yes | yes | 40 |
| Granite Ridge Collective Elite Pass | yes | yes | 150 |

The two lane entitlements are carried or not carried; they are never carried in part. Early lift loading appears from the Granite Ridge Summit Plus Pass upward, and the priority lift lane only on the two collective tiers.

The parking figure is a number of days for the season, published as 0 on the two lowest tiers and as 150 on the Granite Ridge Collective Elite Pass, which is the number of days that tier admits the holder on.
